payload.title: Enforce prepared coding-task proposal budget before further mutation
payload.summary: P1 bounded host-limit defect: prepared CodingTask maximum_proposals=1 and maximum_calls=3 is accepted by configuration. A scripted first proposal changes value() from0 to2 and fails the independent oracle; a second proposal changes2 to1 and is admitted/accepted. Receipt reports limits.proposals=1, proposals_admitted=2 and model_calls_attempted=2. The proposal counter/increment/terminal failure check exists only inside native tools branches. Absolute model-call cap remains enforced; no unbounded execution or protected-main publication is claimed.
payload.benefit: Make the existing host proposal budget effective in prepared and on-demand protocols. With one failed allowed proposal, do not dispatch/admit a second edit or automatic repair; record truthful exhaustion and known-source restoration. Independently test caps1/default3, refused and admitted proposals, unchanged valid default behavior, model-call cap versus proposal cap, multi-component transaction accounting as one proposal, and current native six-proposal semantics. Verify public wrappers and any frozen assignment action totals are compatible; preserve existing limits and durable contracts rather than relaxing them. Full final-tree protected100% branch coverage and supported static checks.
payload.uncertainty: Semantic task/proposal bounds already exist; no new lifecycle or policy engine needed. This bug is independent from frozen-input acceptance and response provenance even though the same orchestration function owns all three. WorkCycle records a separate actions.total frame; inspect its relation during repair instead of claiming the prepared bug bypasses every grant. No existing approved story or generic investigation explicitly fixes this demonstrated mode-specific cap failure.
